source_defect_bindings.required_reader_repair: Do not reproduce universal maximal-ideal nilpotence. State the valid localized form (mR_m)^n=0 with a uniform exponent, or a correct proper Jacobson-radical formulation.
source_defect_bindings.counterexample: K × K has dimension zero but neither maximal ideal is nilpotent.

source_defect_bindings.required_reader_repair: Replace <m by <n and use the lowest nonzero homogeneous component of G, whose product with F_m cannot cancel.
Replace n_j by m_j, matching the preceding summands m_1,...,m_n.
Render d(f) as the class [f-f(P)] in m/m^2; all Leibniz equalities in the proof are congruences/classes modulo m^2, not equalities in R.
Explain (nM_+) as the monomial ideal spanned/generated by T^m for m in nM_+, not scalar multiplication of a subset.
The n summands must lie in M_+, not merely M.
